name: Patisa (Jammu Patisa)
instructions: 1. Dry roast gram flour and all-purpose flour in ghee until golden brown and aromatic.
2. In a separate pan, heat sugar and water to prepare a sugar syrup of one-string consistency.
3. Pour the syrup over the flour mixture and stir vigorously to incorporate.
4. Transfer the mixture to a greased tray and spread it out evenly.
5. Press slivered pistachios and almonds into the surface while the mixture is still warm.
6. Allow it to set until firm, then cut into square pieces.
description: Jammu Patisa, often associated with the Patnitop and Jammu regions, is a beloved flaky, crispy, and sweet confection. It is a cultural staple during festive occasions and is highly sought after by tourists as a popular souvenir from the region.
